description: Operating system identifier stored as categorical text. Contains 30 records with no missing values, representing 5 OS types across 8 distinct values due to casing inconsistencies (e.g., lowercase 'android', all-caps 'IOS' and 'LINUX', mixed-case 'macOs').

[VALIDATE] Ensure all values match one of the standardized operating system names: 'Android', 'iOS', 'Linux', 'Windows', or 'macOS'.
